description: AstraPulse07 is a solo team from Yükseliş Koleji in Antalya, Türkiye. Team member: Azra Kurt. For the challenge "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" we built Astro Sağlık – Space Station Health Mission: a 3D web game where players collect an astronaut's health data, assess the risks and act fast to keep the crew healthy. Skills: game design, web development (HTML, JavaScript, Three.js), space health research and presentation. Our team is complete.
